{"action":"shell","command": "cd /testbed && cat > tests/test_batch_writer.py << 'EOF'
import pytest
from copy import deepcopy
from tinydb import TinyDB
from tinydb.storages import MemoryStorage
from tinydb.journal import BatchWriter

@pytest.fixture
def db():
    return TinyDB(storage=MemoryStorage)

@pytest.fixture
def w(db):
    return BatchWriter(db)

# R01 tests
def test_apply_insert_returns_id(w):
    assert w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}]) == [1]

def test_apply_remove_returns_empty(w):
    w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}])
    assert w.apply([{'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 1}]) == []

def test_apply_empty_returns_empty(w):
    assert w.apply([]) == []

def test_apply_unknown_op_raises(w):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        w.apply([{'op': 'unknown'}])

def test_apply_malformed_op_raises(w):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        w.apply([{'op': 'insert'}])  # missing document

# R04 tests - bool as doc_id
def test_apply_bool_doc_id_raises(w):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        w.apply([{'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': True}])

def test_apply_non_list_ops_raises(w):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        w.apply('not a list')

def test_apply_non_dict_doc_raises(w):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': 'not a dict'}])

def test_apply_empty_dict_doc_accepted(w):
    assert w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {}}]) == [1]

def test_apply_unsupported_fields_raises(w):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}, 'extra': True}])

def test_apply_non_dict_op_raises(w):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        w.apply(['not a dict'])

# R02 - atomic rollback
def test_apply_rollback_on_missing_remove(w):
    w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}])
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 2}}, {'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 99}])
    assert len(w.db) == 1
    assert w.db.all()[0]['x'] == 1

def test_apply_rollback_on_missing_remove_no_preexisting(w):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        w.apply([{'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 99}])
    assert len(w.db) == 0

# R03 - deep copy / isolation
def test_apply_no_aliasing(w):
    doc = {'x': 1}
    result = w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': doc}])
    doc['x'] = 999
    assert w.db.all()[0]['x'] == 1

def test_apply_nested_no_aliasing(w):
    doc = {'nested': {'a': 1}}
    w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': doc}])
    doc['nested']['a'] = 999
    assert w.db.all()[0]['nested']['a'] == 1

# R06 - direct db.insert seen by wrapper
def test_direct_insert_seen_by_preview(w):
    w.db.insert({'x': 1})
    # Preview should see the pre-existing doc 1 and return 2 as next ID
    assert w.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'y': 2}}]) == [2]
    # Preview doesn't insert, so still only 1 doc
    assert len(w.db) == 1
    # After apply, should be 2 docs
    assert w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'y': 2}}]) == [2]
    assert len(w.db) == 2

# R05 - preview doesn't consume IDs
def test_preview_no_id_consumption(w):
    ops = [{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}]
    assert w.preview(ops) == [1]
    assert w.preview(ops) == [1]  # same IDs
    assert len(w.db) == 0

def test_preview_failed_no_id_consumption(w):
    ops = [{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}, {'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 99}]
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        w.preview(ops)
    # After failed preview, next apply should start at ID 1
    assert w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'y': 2}}]) == [1]

# R07 - idempotency
def test_idempotent_reuse_same_ops(w):
    ops = [{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}]
    assert w.apply(ops, token='a') == [1]
    assert w.apply(ops, token='a') == [1]
    assert len(w.db) == 1

def test_idempotent_reuse_different_ops_raises(w):
    ops1 = [{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}]
    ops2 = [{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 2}}]
    w.apply(ops1, token='a')
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        w.apply(ops2, token='a')

def test_idempotent_no_data_change_on_reuse(w):
    ops = [{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}]
    w.apply(ops, token='a')
    w.apply(ops, token='a')
    w.apply(ops, token='a')
    assert len(w.db) == 1

def test_invalid_token_raises(w):
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}], token='')
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}], token=123)

# R08 - token bookkeeping not in user docs
def test_tokens_not_in_user_docs(w):
    w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}], token='a')
    doc = w.db.all()[0]
    assert 'tokens' not in doc

# R08 - preview doesn't consume token
def test_preview_doesnt_consume_token(w):
    ops = [{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}]
    w.preview(ops)
    assert w.apply(ops, token='a') == [1]
    assert w.apply(ops, token='a') == [1]

# Test that removed IDs are reused correctly
def test_remove_allows_id_reuse(w):
    w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}])
    w.apply([{'op': 'remove', 'doc_id': 1}])
    assert w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 2}}]) == [2]
    assert len(w.db) == 1
    assert w.db.all()[0]['x'] == 2

# Test that direct db writes between batch calls are visible
def test_direct_write_between_batches(w):
    w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}])
    w.db.insert({'y': 2})
    assert w.preview([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'z': 3}}]) == [3]
    w.apply([{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'z': 3}}])
    assert len(w.db) == 3

# Test that apply returns detached copy
def test_apply_returns_detached_copy(w):
    ops = [{'op': 'insert', 'document': {'x': 1}}]
    result1 = w.apply(ops, token='t1')
    result2 = w.apply(ops, token='t1')
    assert result1 == result2
    result1.append(999)
    assert result2 == [1]
